फ: फ ph. The 22nd consonant and aspirate of the preceding.
फ (फः) 1. m. Increasing; a gale; a yawning; fertility; a mystical rite. f. Distress. n. Angry speech; bubbling up. f. n. Idle speech.
फक्क: फक्क फक्कति 1. a. To creep; to move slowly; to behave ill, be wicked.
फक्किका: फक्किका (का) 1. f. A position; logi-cal exposition; sophism.
फञ्जिका: फञ्जिका (का) 1. f. A plant (Siphonan-thus); a species of hedysarum.
फट: फट (टः-टा-टं) a. The expanded hood of the cobra de capello. m. f. A tooth; a cheat, a rogue.
फट्: फट् adv. Exclamation of no mean-ing used in incantation.
फण्: फण् फणति 1. a. To go; to produce easily or readily; to be oily. फाणयति (causal) to dilute; to shine. फणयति (क) to cause to go.
फण: फण (णः-णा-णं) 1. m. f. n. The expand-ed hood of the cobra de capello.
फणमणि: फण-मणि (णिः) 2. f. Jewel in the serpent's head.
फणिज्झक: फणि-ज्झक (कः) 1. m. A plant (Ma-rua). f. (का) A sort of basil.
फर्फरीक: फर्फरीक (कः) 1. m. The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. n. Sweetness; suavity.
फल: फल फलति 1. a. To produce or bear fruit, to fructify; to go. (ञि, आ) to divide; split.
फल (लं) 1. n. Fruit; prosperity; gain; a shield; a blade; a ber-ry; nutmeg; menses; a gift; plough-share; quotient; area of a circle; equation. m. f. A plant (Echites antidysenterica).
फलक: फलक (कः-कं) 1. m. n. A shield; bench; plant; layer. m. Os frontis; a leaf; Messua ferrea. n. Buttocks.
फलकपाणि: फलक-पाणि (णिः) 2. m. A soldier armed with a shield.
फलकिन्: फलकिन् (की) 5. m. A sort of fish. a. Armed with a shield.
फलत्रय: फल-त्रय (यं) 1. n. Three sorts of fruit collectively; three myrobalans.
फलत्रिक: फल-त्रिक (कं) 1. n. The three my-robalans collectively.
फलद: फल-द (दः) 1. m. A tree. a. Yielding fruit.
फलनिवृत्ति: फल-निवृत्ति (त्तिः) 2. f. Cessation of results or consequences.
फलपाक: फल-पाक (कः) 1. m. The ripening of fruit; caronda; complete result.
फलपुच्छ: फल-पुच्छ (च्छः) 1. m. A sort of escu-lent root or bulb.
फलप्रयुक्त: फल-प्रयुक्त (क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) a. Connected with fruit; yielding fruit.
फलमुद्गरिका: फल-मुद्गरिका (का) 1. f. A sort of date.
फलमूलानिलाशन: फल-मूला-निला-शन (नः-ना-नं) a. Feed-ing on fruits, roots, and air.
फलसम्भव: फल-सम्भव (वः-वा-वं) a. Arising from fruit, profit or success.
फलाकाङ्क्षा: फला_का_ङ्क्षा (ङ्क्षा) 1. f. Hope, desire or expectation of fruit.
फलाशिन्: फला_शिन् (शी-शिनी-शि) a. Living on fruit as an ascetic.
फलासक्त: फला_सक्त (क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) a. Loving fruit; acting for reward.
फलित: फलित (तः) 1. m. A tree. a. Fruitful.
फलिन्: फलिन् (ली-लिनी-लि) a. Bearing fruit. m. A sort of fish; a tree in fruit. f. A medicinal plant, a potherb; a flower.
फलूष: फलूष (षः) 1. m. A sort of creeper.
फलोत्तमा: फलो_त्तमा (मा) 1. f. A small sort of rope; benefit of sacred study.
फलोदय: फलो_दय (यः) 1. m. Gain, profit; heaven; joy; consequence.
फलोद्देश: फलो_द्देश (शः) 1. m. Regard to re-sults or consequences.
फल्गु: फल्गु (ल्गुः) 2. f. The opposite leaved fig-tree; name of a river; false-hood; a red powder; spring; season. a. Sapless; vain; weak.
फल्गुन: फल्गुन (नः) 1. m. A name of Arju-na; of a month, (Feb.-March;) of a constellation.
फल्य: फल्य (ल्यं) 1. n. A bud, a flower.
फाट्: फाट् adv. An interjection of calling.
फाणि: फाणि (णिः) 2. f. Unrefined sugar, molasses; flour mixed with curd.
फाण्ट: फाण्ट (ण्टः-ण्टा-ण्टं) a. Readily pre-pared (by decoction, &c.) n. Di-luted decoction; first particles of butter produced by churning.
फाल: फाल (लः) 1. m. A name of a Shiva; of Balarāma. n. A plough share a. Made of cotton (clothes).
फालकृष्ट: फाल-कृष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) a. Ploughed or furrowed (a field).
फाल्गुन: फाल्गुन (नः) 1. m. A name of Ar-juna; name of a month; name of a tree. f. (नी) Day of the full moon in it; name of the 11th and 12th lunar asterisms.
फाल्गुनिक: फाल्गुनिक (कः) 1. m. The month Phālguna, February-March.
फुट: फुट (टः-टा-टं) 1. m. f. n. The hood or expanded neck of a snake.
फुत्: फुत् adv. Expression of contempt; sound of bubbling or blowing.
फुत्कार: फु-त्कार (रः-रा-रं) a. Disdainful. m. Sound of bubbling or blowing.
फुत्कृत: फु-त्कृत (तः-ता-तं) a. Blown out; blown upon; cooled.
फुल्ल्: फुल्ल् फुल्लति 1. a. To blow or blossom.
फुल्लनयन: फुल्ल-नयन (नः-ना-नं) a. Large-eyed; smiling, looking happy.
फुल्ललोचन: फुल्ल-लोचन (नः) 1. m. A species of the antelope. n. A full eye. a. Full-eyed, pleased.
फेत्कार: फेत्कार (रः) 1. m. Sound of a rushing wind.
फेन: फेन (नः) 1. m. Froth, foam; cuttle-fish bone; vapour.
फेनक: फेनक (कः) 1. m. Cuttle-fish bone. f. (का) Boiled rice; soap berry.
फेनवाहिन्: फेन-वाहिन् (ही) 5. m. Thunderbolt of Indra. a. Froth-bearing.
फेनिल: फेनिल (लः) 1. m. The soap plant. n. Fruit of the jujube. a. Frothy.
फेरव: फेरव (वः) 1. m. Jackal; demon; fraudulent, crafty, malicious.
फेल: फेल (ऋ) फेलति 1. a. To go or move.
